sections.title: Overview

sections.title: Project 1: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) System
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description
Build a comprehensive ERP system that manages all aspects of a business including HR, finance, inventory, and customer relationships.

### 📋 Core Requirements
- **Classes and Objects**: Employee, Department, Product, Customer, Order
- **Inheritance**: Different employee types, product categories, order types
- **Encapsulation**: Secure data access, private methods for calculations
- **Polymorphism**: Different payment methods, report generators
- **Abstraction**: Abstract base classes for business entities
- **Advanced Concepts**: Class methods, static methods, properties
- **Design Patterns**: Factory pattern for object creation, Observer for notifications

### 🔧 Implementation Process
1. **Design the Core Architecture**
   - Create abstract base classes for all business entities
   - Implement inheritance hierarchies for different business objects
   - Design interfaces for different modules (HR, Finance, Inventory)

2. **Build HR Management Module**
   - Employee hierarchy with different roles and permissions
   - Payroll system with inheritance and polymorphism
   - Attendance tracking and performance management

3. **Develop Financial Management**
   - Account hierarchy with different account types
   - Transaction processing with multiple payment methods
   - Financial reporting with polymorphic report generators

4. **Create Inventory Management**
   - Product hierarchy with different categories
   - Stock management with encapsulation
   - Supplier and purchase order management

5. **Implement Customer Relationship Management**
   - Customer hierarchy with different customer types
   - Order processing with inheritance
   - Customer service and support tracking

6. **Add Advanced Features**
   - Data persistence with file operations
   - User authentication and authorization
   - Reporting and analytics dashboard

sections.title: Project 2: E-commerce Platform with Microservices Architecture
sections.body:
### 🎯 Project Description

### 📋 Core Requirements

- **Inheritance**: Product categories, user types, payment methods
- **Encapsulation**: Secure user data, private business logic
- **Polymorphism**: Different payment processors, shipping providers
- **Abstraction**: Abstract services and interfaces
- **Advanced Concepts**: Metaclasses for service registration, descriptors
- **Design Patterns**: Strategy pattern for payment/shipping, Singleton for configuration

### 🔧 Implementation Process
1. **Design Service Architecture**
   - Create abstract service base classes
   - Implement service interfaces and contracts
   - Design service communication patterns

2. **Build User Management Service**
   - User hierarchy with different roles
   - Authentication and authorization system
   - Profile management with encapsulation

3. **Develop Product Catalog Service**

6. **Add Shipping and Logistics**

sections.title: Project Development Guidelines
sections.body:
### Phase 1: Architecture Design (2-3 hours)
- Analyze requirements and design system architecture
- Create class hierarchies and relationships
- Plan inheritance structures and interfaces
- Design data flow and system interactions

### Phase 2: Core Implementation (8-10 hours)
- Implement base classes and inheritance hierarchies
- Add encapsulation and data protection
- Create polymorphic behaviors
- Implement abstract base classes and interfaces

### Phase 3: Advanced Features (4-6 hours)
- Add design patterns and advanced OOPs concepts
- Implement properties and descriptors
- Create class methods and static methods
- Add metaclasses where appropriate

### Phase 4: Integration and Testing (3-4 hours)
- Integrate all system components
- Test all OOPs scenarios and edge cases
- Optimize performance and fix bugs
- Add comprehensive error handling

### Phase 5: Documentation and Deployment (2-3 hours)
- Create comprehensive documentation
- Prepare deployment instructions
- Create user guides and API documentation
- Prepare presentation materials
